verdict.rationale: Reconciling settlements to their underlying charges is a fair question for a payments processor, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no settlements, payouts-to-merchant, or balance-transaction listing API, and no way to map a bank deposit to the charges that make it up. Transfer, bulk-transfer and payout-event webhook docs cover outbound payments and event notifications, which are adjacent features, not settlement reconciliation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
